g.text: Single sign-on (OpenID Connect, authorization code + PKCE) — UML 2.5.1 sequence diagram, as built
[state unknown, used, expired, or cookie mismatch]
GET JWKS (cached; refetched on unknown kid)
verify(token, keys, issuer, client id, nonce)
(role from this app; unknown -> deny or Viewer)
Message numbers are a reading aid for class discussion only. UML 2.5.1 orders the messages
of a sequence diagram by their vertical position, so sequence numbers are not required
(numbered sequence expressions belong to communication diagrams).
